environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB with no request validation. The ALB performs simple path-based routing to the target group. No WAF is attached. The service is exposed to internal corporate network users who authenticate via OAuth2 bearer tokens. The filterExpression field accepts arbitrary strings from authenticated users.

config.network: ALB with path-based routing, no WAF attached
config.auth: OAuth2 bearer token validation (any authenticated user can call endpoint)
